description: Verifies the secular J2 perturbation of low Earth orbits: the sun-synchronous inclination, the equatorial and polar nodal rates, the vanishing apsidal drift at the critical inclination, the size of the J4 correction, and the nodal drift of a numerically integrated 98.2 degree orbit against the analytic rate.

checks.label: the sun-synchronous inclination yields a nodal drift of one revolution per tropical year
the equatorial nodal rate equals -3/2 n J2 (R/p)^2
a polar orbit has no J2 nodal drift
the apsidal drift vanishes at the critical inclination
the J4 term changes the nodal rate
the J4 correction stays small against the J2 rate
at least thirty ascending node crossings are detected
the regression slope of the node longitude matches the analytic J2 rate within 2 percent
